manifest.goal: Construct and test a non-circular sufficient-condition route toward the full token-native fractal HSWM target, preserving FCL-1..8, existing negative results, strong controls and claim ceilings.

sources.title: OpenAI reported research method; stronger internal discovery model, Astra formalization
Integrated first research round and rejected static-wrapper design
Constructive proof program and explicit open obligations
Existing model-only proof and open reality bridges
Full FCL-1..8 operational contracts and claim ceilings

hypotheses.claim: A computable, nontrivial construction may satisfy the full operational FCL contracts in an explicit nonempty bounded environment class; this existential claim is unproved.
hypotheses.scope: CR-0..7 proof program only. The classical finite-policy derivation supplies no HSWM efficacy or full-cell witness.
hypotheses.falsifier: A counterexample defeats the proposed construction or its sufficient conditions; reject that construction without changing the target. Vacuous assumptions, supplied Gain/Cognitive premises and copied-wrapper equivalence cannot discharge this claim.

hypotheses.claim: The finite-policy benefit is explainable by an ordinary text/program learner with the same rule, candidates and observations.
hypotheses.scope: Explicit strong null for the classical starting lemma; frozen-policy improvement is not HSWM-specific advantage.
hypotheses.falsifier: A distinct non-equivalent mechanism survives a valid prospective strong-learner comparison and specified interventions; the current elementary lemma does not do this.

tasks.question: Choose the smallest useful formalization of section 5: derive selection behavior from explicit estimation error, then isolate the probability and fresh-draw assumptions. Reuse pinned tooling; do not assume strictGain or promote the lemma to full HSWM.
tasks.acceptance: Exact theorem statement, axiom/premise list, arithmetic proof or counterexample, non-vacuity example, and explicit gap to the strongest learner; actual machine-check status distinguished from proposed work.

tasks.question: Replace opaque causalIdentification in one prospective bounded design with explicit potential outcomes, assignment, consistency and intervention/interference assumptions. Derive the estimand without assuming causality or positive effect.
tasks.acceptance: Defined treatment and contrast, derivation and countermodels for violated assumptions; no edits to frozen DNRD-5 or prior scientific verdicts.

tasks.question: Seek one computable nontrivial base-cell and composition construction covering CR-0..7. Identify explicit gaps, witness incompatibility, hidden oracles, strong program equivalence and composition interference.
tasks.acceptance: Map every FCL to concrete dynamics and a proof obligation. Do not substitute isolated toy witnesses, typed nesting or an assumed preservation predicate for a full-cell existence proof.

tasks.question: Attack quantifiers, hidden gain/causal premises, non-vacuity, fresh-evaluation independence, equal-cap comparisons and composition error accumulation.
tasks.acceptance: List exact invalid steps or preserved scope, including whether an ordinary learner completely explains each claimed benefit.

tasks.question: Integrate surviving lemmas into one explicit construction or record the precise unresolved obstacle, and derive a discriminating experiment from its unverified assumptions.
tasks.acceptance: Keep conditional proof, existence witness, source refinement and actual external occurrence distinct. Reuse RU-1 only if its mechanism matches the derived contract; no success-threshold changes or target reduction.

tasks.question: Independently check the resulting source-bound proof statements, available build evidence, counterexamples and remaining assumptions.
tasks.acceptance: Report actual checked artifacts and all open premises. No whole-HSWM promotion from a selector lemma or finite-depth structural induction.
